title: Final Current Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the current I in terms of A, V, μ, τ, and other constants.

title: Density Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the electron density n(p) correctly using the given equations.

title: Effective Area Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly account for the effective area A cos(θ) in the rate of electrons escaping.

title: Integration Limits
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and apply the limits of integration for the momentum variable p.

title: Exponential Approximation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention the approximation used for the exponential term when V - μ >> τ.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the final expression for current.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all terms in the final expression have consistent units.
